# Correctness v1.2: v1.1 Defects

## v1.1 defects addressed in v1.2
- **V1.1-01**: ``tensor_lineage_metrics`` was called without ``trusted_cart``. The new API accepts ``trusted_cartesian`` explicitly and is tested to detect trusted/project/stored discrepancies independently.
- **V1.1-02**: ``piezo_voigt_total`` is now labelled ``processed Voigt`` unless upstream parser history is demonstrated. Lineage levels L0/L1/L2 are reported honestly.
- **V1.1-03**: Gate B now uses ``n_verified / n_available`` and reports coverage separately. Missing fields are no longer counted as failures.
- **V1.1-04**: This script does not import or run Phase 5A/5B, baselines, PMR, soft-mode, e3nn, or O(3) transport analysis.
